title: Fix Change Test Backward Diff In Csharp And Python
description: Fix the Change test backward diff failures in C# and Python. The test Metabolism_Kit_Change_Forward_Backward_Inverse_Behavior fails in both languages with backward diff not matching expected inverse diff. TypeScript and Go pass the same test.
summary: Fixed the pre-existing Change test failure (Metabolism_Kit_Change_Forward_Backward_Inverse_Behavior) in both C# and Python. The issue was that the expected fixture metabolism.kit.diff.inverted.semio.json was missing guid fields in layer attributes of added designs. The computed backward diff correctly includes these guids (sourced from the original kit), but the fixture had been generated without them. Updated the fixture to include all 12 layer attribute guids. All tests now pass: Python 49/49, C# 46/46, TS 108/108, Go all pass.
